main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
header_desc: By interweaving the spirituality of the 1st century with the physics of the 21st century, this work addresses the fundamental question of our place in the universe. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in texts two thousand years old: within us resides the divine spark, and by inverting the map of reality, we elevate consciousness from the plane of thought to that of feeling to free ourselves from matter.
left_title: The Return to the ONE: The ego has mass
left_body: If the ego curves space-time, matter emerges from the psyche, and the cosmos's timelessness responds to the pneuma, reality reveals itself as an act of perception. Consciousness oscillates between the states lvert ONE ⟩ and lvert EGO ⟩, granting us a fundamental free will formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. Just as matter and space-time mutually shape their geometry, the ego imposes a mass that distorts the experience of being; shedding that illusory gravity is the true return to the pure light of the Ineffable Father.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it makes no sense to pray to the law of gravity
universe_light_text: The Father and I, we are one: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere lies the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Duality of human consciousness: the timeless light of divine feeling in the right hemisphere versus the temporal density of material thought in the left hemisphere.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere dwells the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: Breaking the chains of illusion is the first step to remembering where we come from. I invite you to see the world with different eyes and discover the horizon of the millennium.
